scenarios.name: graveyard-ability-unavailable-with-one-white-permanent
scenarios.why: One Savannah Lions is one white permanent, one short of the stated two-permanent threshold.

scenarios.name: graveyard-ability-offered-with-two-white-permanents
scenarios.why: Two Savannah Lions are two white permanents, exactly meeting the minimum for the ability.

scenarios.name: graveyard-card-bottomed-at-two-white-permanents
scenarios.why: At exactly two white permanents the restriction is met; paying white mana and tapping the land activates its targeted ability, moving the chosen graveyard card to the bottom of its owner's library.
